name: io.github.duongnq2798/atropyle
description: Inheritance and recovery vaults on X Layer: read, simulate, verify and prepare. Never signs.

environmentVariables.name: ATROPYLE_CHAIN
environmentVariables.description: Chain to use: xlayer (default) or local

environmentVariables.name: ATROPYLE_DEPLOYMENT
environmentVariables.description: Path to a deployment JSON file; wins over ATROPYLE_CHAIN. Without it the server reads X Layer mainnet

environmentVariables.name: ATROPYLE_RPC
environmentVariables.description: Read RPC URL of the same chain; can contain an API key
